india_trends.title: End of the road for Jensen Huang? Nvidia Board Chairman Harvey Jones says no intention to rehire him as CEO
india_trends.summary: Nvidia Chairman Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO.
